descFull: Automatic DNS records for containers, VMs & clusters. Seven sources (Traefik, Caddy, nginx-proxy, native labels, Kubernetes, Proxmox VE, Incus) and eleven DNS providers including the self-hosted ones most tools skip: Technitium, Pi-hole, AdGuard. Split-horizon out of the box. external-dns for the homelab.
